key_concepts: The brain processes information and sends instructions to the body
The heart pumps blood and distributes nutrients to all parts of the body
The lungs filter oxygen that enters the body
The liver helps the kidneys filter waste in the blood
The kidneys remove body wastes like urea and urine
The stomach breaks down food into nutrients
The intestines are where final digestion and absorption of food take place
Bones protect major organs and help muscles allow movement
Major organs are connected to two or more other organs to perform their functions
The brain serves as the command center of the body
The heart pumps blood to the lungs to get oxygen and remove carbon dioxide
The stomach breaks food into smaller pieces so the small intestines can absorb nutrients
